notes: The Imam is named after «عن», so he stays narrator (ruling 2); the blessing is left out
«قُلْتُ فَإِنْ عَادَ» inside the saying is a question, not a link, and the text does not say who asks it
The SWI flag says the route is given elsewhere; the text does not say so and writes a full chain

fixes.reason: RWY reads the Imam's name with the blessing and the word أنه attached, so its route ends in a machine-read surface.

evidence.quote: عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ
أبي عبد الله عليه السلام أنه
